title: Storia di un Caravan | Il punto esatto di Francesca Mannocchi | Lucy sulla cultura
text: Siamo in origine di Ramata Golan, che è in l'orso. Abbiamo qui tre anni fa quando il place era stato stato stato stato stato stato. I had a tour business and I have a family, a dear wife and 8 kids decided to move here to the town so we came here with all our 8 kids left the business behind. First, we're very much connected to the Zionist idea. And my parents came from the United States. And they left everything they had. They left their families. They left their careers. And they came to Israel. That was 50 years ago. I was educated in a Zionist way.
